topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% efficiency directly translates to reduced power output, impacting link quality by increasing signal degradation and interference. This necessitates higher antenna gains to compensate for signal loss, potentially requiring more sophisticated modulation schemes and coding techniques. The 41% efficiency also exacerbates atmospheric attenuation, further degrading signal strength and impacting the link budget. The tradeoffs include increased system complexity and cost, emphasizing the need for careful antenna design and system architecture optimization.
